content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NIT Durgapur Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.nitdgp.ac.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 17-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Guest Coach positions at NIT Durgapur?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Guest Coach positions at NIT Durgapur is 17th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the institute by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Guest Coach roles?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Guest Coach positions is Rs. 175 per hour. This is a contractual role, and the payment is based on the hours worked.

faq.question: Q3. How can I apply for the Guest Coach posts?
faq.answer: Applications need to be submitted offline. You must download the application form from the official website, fill it out, and send it along with necessary documents to the address specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What are the minimum qualifications required for the Guest Coach positions?
faq.answer: The minimum qualifications include a Diploma in Coaching or a Diploma in Gym & Fitness Trainer, a professional level of coaching course, or having played at an international or national level.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the NIT Durgapur Guest Coach recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies for Guest Coach posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies for the Guest Coach positions, with specific roles for Football, Kabaddi, Handball, and Gymnasium (Male).

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves a Biodata Screening. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their submitted biodata and qualifications.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of NIT Durgapur, which is www.nitdgp.ac.in. Links are provided in the "Important Links" section.

faq.question: Q9. Are there any age limit restrictions for applying?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any minimum or maximum age limits for the Guest Coach positions. It is advisable to check the detailed notification for any specific guidelines.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for these Guest Coach positions?
faq.answer: The Guest Coach positions are on a contractual basis. This means the employment is for a fixed term as per the terms and conditions mentioned in the recruitment notification.
